name: trilly_pf_v1

entry.fill: first post-grad swap >= gts+2s within 30s, slip<=15% vs at-grad quote, dust-fill guard

feature_defs.f_value: net_flow_sol = sum(buy SOL)-sum(sell SOL) over pre-grad curve swaps (t<=gts)
feature_defs.f_momentum: buyer_accel = uniq buyers in 2nd half of [first_swap,gts] / (uniq buyers 1st half +1)
feature_defs.f_size: log1p(total SOL transacted on the curve, t<=gts)
feature_defs.f_holders: net_holders = wallets with sum(buy tokens) > sum(sell tokens) by gts
feature_defs.f_top1: top-1 buyer SOL / total buy SOL

label_trained_on: cum_0 >= 100 SOL post-grad buy-demand at break-even (selection target only)

sizing.fills: split-impact entry-half x exit-half S/(S+flow), 15s exit-flow window, 1% fee

data_parity: features computed from Helius firehose pre-grad curve (pumpfundata-parity); post-grad label/fills validated on Birdeye raw30k (offline only)
model_file: model.txt (LightGBM, trained on all 57 days for forward paper use)
